name: Yeongjo of Joseon
legacy: This person is most remembered for his reform of the taxation system, and persistent efforts to reconcile the various political factions through his Tangpyeong policy, which focused on keeping a strict numerical balance of officials from opposing factions in key government offices.
image_credit: Chae Yong-sin / Jo Seokjin · Public domain

checks.lead: Yeongjo (Korean: 영조; Hanja: 英祖; 31 October 1694 – 22 April 1776), personal name Yi Geum, was the 21st monarch of Joseon. The second son of King Sukjong, he acceded to the throne upon the death of his elder half-brother, King Gyeongjong. His life was characterized by political infighting and resentment due to his biological mother's low-born origins.
